scope: Stripe Checkout sandbox v2, signed webhook/ledger, expiry/reconciliation and storefront integration

apiTests.command: npm.cmd run test:e2e:isolated -- test/stripe.e2e-spec.ts test/storefront.e2e-spec.ts --no-file-parallelism --testTimeout=180000 --bail=1 --reporter=verbose -t "releases expired|rolls back|expires orders|Database seed and storefront commerce"
apiTests.stripeEvidence: Six cases passed before an overall test timeout in expiry/reconciliation; the remaining three passed in the selected run with a 180-second test limit. No claim of all nine passing together in a final clean run.
apiTests.provider: fake gateway; genuine Stripe SDK signing/verification with fixture secret
apiTests.database: real PostgreSQL; fresh random test schema/media, cleaned by each suite
